answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 34947 Country: India Title: I have purchased a piece of land. Right now the intention is to build house some time on the same land Question: (1) I have purchased a piece of land. Right now the intention is to build house some time on the same land. Is zakah needed to be paid on the same? (2) I have purchased a piece of land(s) with no intention as of now. One major intention is to sell it out and use the money to construct house in point 1 land purchased or else use this also to build a house. Please provide ruling on this kind of land for zakah payment. Answer ID: 34947 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1802/1437/B=1432) Zakah is not wajib on any house mentioned above. Zakah is wajib on that land or house that is purchased with the intention of business. If there is no intention of business at the time of purchasing then no zakah is wajib on it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
